title: Pluto Pack
description: Optimization and easy Multiplayer features for a Vanilla+ experience!
body:
This Modpack was initially created for the Pluto Discord server of my friends and I.

I thought I would share what I believe to be the best vanilla+ mods for a core survival experience for solo or multiplayer. Mostly compromised of optimization, performance and visual mods.

Includes popular mods like Voxy and Dynamic Lights to beautify your world!

None of the content in this pack is my own and I highly encourage supporting all of the original creators!

Have fun!
